categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the optical communication industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance optical modules. Its product portfolio includes a full range of optical modules for applications in AI/machine learning clusters, cloud data centers, data communications, 5G wireless networks, telecom transmission, and fixed network access. The company also produces coherent optical modules and silicon photonics modules, serving both domestic and international customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as VCSEL/EML, silicon photonics, thin-film lithium niobate, and coherent optical communication. It has expertise in high-speed optical device chip packaging and optical device packaging. Production is mainly order-based, managed via an ERP system to optimize material usage and control costs. The company emphasizes continuous process optimization, automation, and lean management to improve production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include communication equipment manufacturers, internet companies, and distributors. The products serve major markets such as AI/machine learning clusters, cloud data centers, telecommunications networks (including 5G front-haul, mid-haul, and backhaul), metropolitan area networks, backbone networks, and core networks. The company has established strong partnerships with leading global internet firms and telecom equipment vendors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas business. It has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, the United States, Singapore, Thailand, and other regions. Overseas sales account for approximately 78.7% of total revenue, indicating a broad international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream of the optical communication supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of optical modules and components. It procures upstream raw materials such as optical chips and integrated circuits and supplies downstream to communication equipment manufacturers and data center operators. The company is pursuing vertical integration to cover optical chip manufacturing, chip packaging, device packaging, and module assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-speed optical modules (100G to 1.6T), silicon photonics, coherent optical modules, and low-power optical modules (LPO). The company invests heavily in R&D, with a focus on AI data center applications, 5G networks, and long-distance transmission modules. It emphasizes talent acquisition, collaboration with industry and academia, and continuous innovation to maintain technological leadership and expand market share.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of optical modules and components to communication equipment manufacturers and internet companies, both domestically and internationally. The company uses direct sales and buyout sales through distributors. Revenue recognition follows shipment and acceptance terms, with FOB, FCA, DDP, and DAP export terms applied for overseas sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few domestic enterprises capable of mass-producing 100G, 400G, and 800G high-speed optical modules and holds a strong market position in China. It competes with global and domestic optical module manufacturers by leveraging advanced packaging technologies and a broad product portfolio. The company aims to strengthen its core competitiveness and become a leading supplier of optical modules, components, and subsystems.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 8.65 billion, a 179% increase from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 2.84 billion, a 312% increase. Total assets nearly doubled to RMB 12.27 billion. The company has shown rapid growth driven by increased market demand and expanded production capacity, including the near completion of a second-phase factory in Thailand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-speed, low-power, and cost-effective optical modules with advanced packaging technologies. It offers a diverse product range covering multiple transmission rates and interfaces, tailored for AI, cloud data centers, and telecom networks. Its flexible production lines and strong R&D capabilities enable rapid response to customer needs and continuous product innovation, providing customers with reliable, high-performance optical communication solutions.
